data.name: Jumanaht
data.gender_notes: Jumanaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'jamana', meaning 'treasury' or 'storehouse'. Jumanaht is a name that signifies abundance and generosity, as well as the idea of being gifted or blessed. The name Jumanaht carries the meaning “Generous, gifted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jumanaht usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, gifted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: a name for a child who is expected to be a source of blessings and grace to those around her
data.etymology: Jumanaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous, gifted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jumanaht total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: جمانة

in_arabic.long_meaning: جمانة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، و يعني الجماني أو اللؤلؤ، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و راقية، و يعتبر من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: جمانہ
in_urdu.meaning: جمانہ کا مطلب ہے جواہر یا موتی
in_urdu.long_meaning: جمانہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے جواہر یا موتی، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورتی اور رفعت کا حامل ہے، اور جنوبی ایشیاء کے مسلمانوں کے درمیان اس کا استعمال بہت زیادہ ہے.

data.cultural_impact: Jumanaht is an evocative name that holds a rich cultural significance, particularly within Islamic contexts. It is a name often given to babies born during the celebration of Eid Al-Fitr, which marks the end of the holy month of Ramadan. The name represents the joyous and abundant spirit of this celebration, embodied by the idea of a jamana or treasury, a storehouse of blessings. It is a reminder of the generosity and kindness that each person should strive to exhibit throughout their life, offering a constant inspiration to foster a spirit of giving and sharing.
data.spiritual_significance: At its core, Jumanaht represents the spiritual blessings and abundance that comes from God, emphasizing the importance of gratitude and faith. Islamic traditions encourage a constant awareness of God's presence and the blessings He bestows upon us. The name serves as a reminder of the idea that everything, from the gift of life to material wealth, ultimately comes from the Divine Treasury. In turn, it inspires the recipient to be generous towards others and thus, embody the essence of God's boundless mercy and love. Each use of the name Jumanaht can serve as a remembrance of this fundamental spiritual truth, which permeates and enriches daily life.
